$comment: Dictionary corrections, written once for both apps: the macOS side (FluenceDictionary, VectorTests) and the Windows side run every case below in CI, and both must agree.

A case lists a dictionary, gives it an input, and states the text that must come back plus, for each correction that fired, its 'to' (the entry's write, unchanged) and its count. The order of those reports is free.
An entry is a 'correction' (hear -> write) or a 'term' (write only). A missing 'hear' is an empty string; a missing 'isEnabled' is true.

The inputs are the kind of thing Clement dictates: French sentences carrying English tech words. Next to every match sits plain ASCII, except in the one decomposed-accent case, so the two regex engines cannot read a neighbour differently.
Deeper Unicode behaviour (full case folding, exotic spaces, letters and digits of other scripts, tie order, chained corrections) is pinned by the Swift tests alone.
Edit this file before either implementation, and keep the Swift copy identical: cp shared/dictionary-test-vectors.json Tests/FluenceDictionaryTests/

'fileCases' (since version 2) pin how dictionary.txt is read: 'text' is the raw file, line endings spelled out (\n, \r\n, or a lone \r: any of them ends a line), and 'expectedEntries' are the entries that come back, in file order. A bare line is a term, 'hear -> write' a correction, '# off:' a disabled entry, any other '#' line a comment; each side is trimmed of spaces and tabs.

cases.name: switched-off correction leaves its trigger alone
cases.input: on migre le front en type script cette semaine
cases.expected: on migre le front en type script cette semaine

cases.name: term entry never rewrites the text
cases.input: le cluster kubernetes tourne bien depuis lundi
cases.expected: le cluster kubernetes tourne bien depuis lundi

cases.name: empty dictionary returns the sentence unchanged
cases.input: Rien à corriger dans cette phrase.
cases.expected: Rien à corriger dans cette phrase.

cases.name: empty dictation stays empty
dot inside a trigger only matches a dot
cases.input: on hésite entre vuexjs et vue.js pour le dashboard
cases.expected: on hésite entre vuexjs et Vue.js pour le dashboard

cases.name: plus signs and brackets inside triggers are plain characters
cases.input: la version (rc) du moteur est en c++, pas en c+ ni en cpp
cases.expected: la version [RC] du moteur est en C++, pas en c+ ni en cpp

cases.name: currency sign trigger ignores the one stuck to a number
cases.input: le serveur coûte $ 20 par mois, ou 20$ hors taxes
cases.expected: le serveur coûte USD 20 par mois, ou 20$ hors taxes

cases.name: replacement keeps dollar references and digits as text
cases.input: le prix promo expire lundi
cases.expected: le $9 ou $0 pour 3 expire lundi

cases.$comment: The report's 'to' is the write exactly, backslashes included.
cases.name: replacement keeps backslashes as text
cases.input: copie le dossier projet sur la clé
cases.expected: copie le C:\dev\0 sur la clé

cases.name: upper and lower case ASCII are the same to a trigger
cases.input: GET HUB, Get Hub ou gEt HuB, c'est pareil
cases.expected: GitHub, GitHub ou GitHub, c'est pareil

cases.name: capitals and padding in the entry itself are ignored
cases.input: on passe tout sur kuber netes demain
cases.expected: on passe tout sur Kubernetes demain

cases.name: write is inserted with its own capitals, not the input's
cases.input: NEXT JS est lent en dev
cases.expected: next.JS est lent en dev

cases.name: accents typed in two pieces still match the one-piece trigger
cases.input: on passe par le réseau privé de la boîte
cases.expected: on passe par le Réseau Privé de la boîte

cases.name: trigger glued to more letters is not a match
cases.input: la base postgresql reste telle quelle, comme postgresx
cases.expected: la base postgresql reste telle quelle, comme postgresx

cases.name: half of a two-word trigger is not a match
cases.input: je get le ticket puis je passe au hub de la gare
cases.expected: je get le ticket puis je passe au hub de la gare

cases.name: quotes, brackets, semicolons and an ASCII apostrophe end a word
cases.input: la clé d'open ai expire; (open ai) et "open ai" aussi, comme open ai's docs
cases.expected: la clé d'OpenAI expire; (OpenAI) et "OpenAI" aussi, comme OpenAI's docs

cases.name: newlines end a word too
cases.input:
ligne un
post gres
ligne trois
cases.expected:
ligne un
Postgres
ligne trois

cases.name: words of a trigger may be written as one
cases.input: le module est en typescript depuis hier
cases.expected: le module est en TypeScript depuis hier

cases.name: words of a trigger may be joined by hyphens
cases.input: kuber-netes, Kuber-Netes et kuber - netes
cases.expected: Kubernetes, Kubernetes et Kubernetes

cases.name: words of a trigger may be far apart on one line
cases.input: je pousse le code sur get    hub ce soir
cases.expected: je pousse le code sur GitHub ce soir

cases.name: three hits of one correction count three
cases.input: cloud code relit la PR, cloud code la corrige, puis cloud code la fusionne
cases.expected: Claude Code relit la PR, Claude Code la corrige, puis Claude Code la fusionne

cases.name: two-word trigger beats the one-word trigger it starts with
cases.input: on migre vers git lab cet hiver
cases.expected: on migre vers GitLab cet hiver

cases.name: one-word trigger still fires where it stands alone
cases.input: git lab pour la CI, git pour le reste
cases.expected: GitLab pour la CI, Git pour le reste

cases.name: unrelated corrections all apply in one sentence
cases.input: le back en type script parle à post gres, et tout part sur get hub
cases.expected: le back en TypeScript parle à Postgres, et tout part sur GitHub
